decisions: Script: LATIN (official; Yandex Eda, Express24, Uzum, daryo/spot.uz ‘oz’ editions). Real sites often type oʻ/gʻ with ‘ (U+2018) or a straight apostrophe — our files use ʻ U+02BB and ʼ U+02BC as the brief requires; search engines generally treat them alike.

Order button: no statutory button wording found in Uzbekistan’s Law “Isteʼmolchilarning huquqlarini himoya qilish toʻgʻrisida”; market norm “Buyurtmani rasmiylashtirish” / “Buyurtma berish”; card variant “{amount} toʻlash”.

Pay at Hatch: recommend “Fudtrakda toʻlash” (feature) / “Olib ketishda toʻlash” (button). Avoid “yetkazib berilganda toʻlash”, “kuryerga naqd toʻlash”, “qabul qilganda toʻlash” (cash-on-delivery sense).
Mobile catering word “keytering” is Low confidence (could be “katering”); a native check is advised.

Telegram, not WhatsApp, is generally reported as Uzbekistan’s dominant messenger (general knowledge, not re-checked here) — WhatsApp auto-replies may matter less for UZ; consider whether to lead with them.
